Pull request: #327

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully.

## Summary

Branch: `bb/relay-121-agent-runtime-08-08-report-ai-utilizat-thr_52evi3pabp` (pushed to origin).

Implemented the read-model core of issue #121: `getAiUsageReport()` in `backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiUsageReport.ts`, aggregating `ai_gateway_calls` over a bounded, validated date range by provider, model, native unit (`tokens` vs `audio_seconds`), and the originating `agent_runs.unit` (`invocation`/`session`, or `null` for calls outside any run). It also returns a per-day cost series (bucketed in the system's configured timezone, matching the daily budget's own reset boundary) with explicit zeros for empty days, plus the current `AiBudgets` for cap/uncapped rendering. Nulls (no token/audio concept for a group) are never coerced to zero.

**Scope note:** the issue also asks for an authenticated `GET /api/ai-usage` HTTP endpoint and a "Semprec System page" graph. This repo currently has no HTTP server, no auth middleware, and no charting library anywhere — `backend/services/` and `web/`'s page layer are explicit scaffolds, and the REST/auth transport is tracked as two separate, still-open epics (`generic-rest` #238-241, `auth-v1` #138-143). Every prior issue in this `agent-runtime` series stayed within `backend/packages/{data,agent-runtime}` for the same reason. I landed the aggregation logic at that same layer so it can be wired directly into a route once those epics land, rather than inventing throwaway server/auth/frontend infrastructure here.

**Test results:**
- Backend build: clean across all 10 packages.
- Backend unit tests: 83/83 passed.
- Backend integration tests: 489/490 passed — the 1 failure (`propertyTypeMigration.test.ts`, a concurrent-migration race test) is pre-existing and unrelated: it fails identically in isolation and touches none of the files this change modifies.
- Backend e2e tests: 5/5 passed.
- Dependency boundary check: no violations.
- Web tests: 81/81 passed (untouched by this change).
- New `aiUsageReport.test.ts` (5 tests): all passing.

Pull request: #327

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed to branch `bb/relay-121-agent-runtime-08-08-report-ai-utilizat-thr_52evi3pabp`.

## Summary

This addresses the code-review/CI feedback on PR #327 for issue #121 ("[agent-runtime 08/08] Report AI utilization").

**Fixed the medium-severity finding:** `run_unit` in `aiUsageReport.ts` is now validated via `assertKnownValue()` before being widened to `AgentRunUnit | null`, per the project's DB-row-validation convention.

**Delivered the previously-missing scope** the review bot flagged as blocking:

- `backend/services/semprec-api`: a new service package exposing authenticated `GET /api/ai-usage`. It's a testable request-handler function (`createAiUsageRequestListener`) rather than a running process — the caller owns the actual HTTP server, matching the existing `@semprec/realtime` wiring pattern. Auth is a stopgap bearer-token check via an explicit parameter (never hardcoded/logged), meant to be swapped out once the `auth-v1` epic lands. `ChokePointError` subclasses map to their HTTP status; unexpected errors return 500. Tested with real HTTP requests against the real ephemeral integration Postgres.
- `web/src/views/aiUsage/UtilizationPage.tsx`: the System page's Utilization graph — an inline-SVG cost-per-day chart with an explicit daily-budget reference line, days over budget highlighted, explicit "uncapped" text when the monthly budget is null, and a breakdown table that represents audio-only calls by their own unit instead of showing 0 tokens. Built on the existing `StateViews` (loading/empty/error), `useTranslate()`, and the `OperationError`/`OperationFailureKind` pattern, with new strings added to both `en` and `cs` catalogs. Routed via a new `?page=ai-usage` composition-root entry (not a choke-point item/view, so it doesn't reuse `?view=`).

**Verification:** backend unit (83/83), integration (495/495 — one known pre-existing/flaky concurrency test reconfirmed unrelated and stable in isolation), and e2e (5/5) suites pass; `check:boundaries` passes; both backend and web typecheck cleanly; web test suite (86/86) passes, including new tests for both the HTTP handler and the Utilization page.

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-121-agent-runtime-08-08-report-ai-utilizat-thr_52evi3pabp`.

This push adds one new commit (`3921113`) on top of the existing PR #327 branch, addressing all open code-review findings:

- **Fixed the client-side secret leak (HIGH)**: `VITE_SEMPREC_API_TOKEN` is no longer read or referenced anywhere in browser-reachable code. The bearer token is now attached server-side only, via the Vite dev proxy reading a non-`VITE_`-prefixed, Node-only env var — it never enters the client bundle.
- **Fixed the swallowed unexpected error (HIGH)**: `aiUsageHandler.ts` now logs unexpected (non-`ChokePointError`) failures with `console.error` before returning a 500, instead of discarding them silently.
- **Fixed the timing-unsafe token comparison (MEDIUM)**: bearer token comparison now uses `crypto.timingSafeEqual` with a length check instead of `===`.

Added test coverage for the length-mismatch short-circuit and the unexpected-error/500-logging path. Full verification passed: backend and web typechecks, backend unit/integration/e2e suites (497+83+5 tests), full web test suite (86 tests), and `check:boundaries` — all clean.
